user.title: Atmos Energy Account
user.description: Enter your Atmos Energy credentials. The prediction mode adds an estimated bill and 7-day usage and cost forecasts; in the Mid-Tex region it also estimates the weather normalization adjustment (WNA).

account.title: Choose Account
account.description: This login has more than one Atmos Energy account. Choose the service address to track. To track another one, add the integration again with the same login.

region.title: Rate Region
region.description: Choose the Atmos Energy rate region on your bill. It decides where the monthly gas cost is fetched from and fills in typical rates on the next page. The weather normalization adjustment (WNA) is estimated for Mid-Tex only.

weather_station.title: Weather Station
weather_station.description: Select the weather station Atmos Energy uses for your area to ensure accurate weather normalization calculations.

cost.title: Rates & Surcharges
cost.description:
With the first box ticked, the customer charge and consumption charge come from the published Atmos tariff rates for your region, checked weekly; the values below are used only when it is off or no published rate is available.

Defaults are this region's residential tariff rates; check them against your latest Atmos Energy bill. Kentucky bills per Mcf: divide by 10 for $/CCF. Put any per-CCF riders (e.g. Mid-Tex's Winter Storm Uri surcharge) in other charges, and local taxes and franchise fees in the percentage.

data.use_published_rates: Keep the customer charge and consumption charge up to date automatically
data.auto_fetch_gcr: Auto-fetch the monthly gas cost (GCR, GCA or PGA)
data.gcr_rate: Gas cost ($/CCF), used when auto-fetch is off or fails

weather_forecast.title: Forecast Integration
weather_forecast.description: Select a weather entity to provide temperature forecasts. This allows the integration to predict your usage for the remainder of the billing cycle.

account_selection.title: Choose an Atmos Energy account for {title}
account_selection.description:
{error}

This login has more than one Atmos Energy account (service address), and the portal returns no usage data until one is chosen. Go to **Settings > Devices & Services > Atmos Energy**, select **Configure** on this entry, and pick the account in the **Choose Account** step. This message clears after the next successful update.

populate_past_usage.name: Populate Past Usage
populate_past_usage.description: Import historical daily gas usage data from an Atmos Energy XLS spreadsheet. Note that this is specifically for DAILY usage spreadsheets, not monthly.

file_path.name: File Path
file_path.description: The path to the Atmos Energy XLS file (e.g., /config/dailyUsage.xls).

config_entry.name: Account
config_entry.description: The Atmos Energy entry to import into. Required when more than one account is set up.

refresh_current_usage.name: Refresh Current Usage
refresh_current_usage.description: Manually trigger a refresh of the current usage and billing data from the Atmos Energy portal, for every configured account.
